Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi

Interface InferenceProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
HttpProvider, OnnxProvider, PmmlProvider, SageMakerProvider, TensorFlowProvider, XGBoostProvider
public interface InferenceProvider
Service Provider Interface (SPI) that lets a model-format implementation (ONNX, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, PMML, remote HTTP/gRPC/SageMaker/Vertex AI, ...) register itself with OtterRuntime without the runtime needing a compile-time dependency on that implementation.

Providers are discovered in one of two ways:

  • Automatic: via ServiceLoader. Implementations should be declared in META-INF/services/com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi.InferenceProvider in the provider module's jar.
  • Manual: via OtterRuntime.builder().provider(myProvider).

Implementation Example:


 public class OnnxProvider implements InferenceProvider {
     public String getProviderId() { return "onnx"; }
     public Set<ModelFormat> getSupportedFormats() { return Set.of(ModelFormat.ONNX); }
     public InferenceEngine<?> createEngine() { return new OnnxInferenceEngine(); }
 }
Then, in META-INF/services/com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi.InferenceProvider: 

 com.codedstream.otterstream.onnx.OnnxProvider

Note this is purely a factory abstraction: it says "given this format, here is a fresh, uninitialized InferenceEngine that can handle it." The existing InferenceEngine/ModelLoader contracts are unchanged; engines are still initialized via InferenceEngine.initialize(com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.config.ModelConfig).

Since:
0.1.0

    • createEngine

      InferenceEngine<?> createEngine()
      Creates a new, uninitialized InferenceEngine instance.

      The caller is responsible for calling InferenceEngine.initialize(com.codedstream.otterstream.inference.config.ModelConfig). A fresh instance must be returned on every call; engines are stateful once initialized and must never be shared across concurrent deployments.

      Returns:
      a new engine instance ready to be initialized

    • getPriority

      default int getPriority()
      Resolution priority when multiple providers support the same format. Higher wins. Defaults to 0.
      Returns:
      priority value
